Summary.Name: DeepRV-CLIP
Summary.Description: DeepCORO-CLIP based binary classifier for right ventricular systolic function (normal vs abnormal) from coronary angiograms.

Mechanism.Outcome: Binary RV systolic function (0 = normal, 1 = abnormal)
Mechanism.Output: Outcome: probability of abnormal RV function after sigmoid
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults undergoing coronary angiography at MHI (TTE-matched within +/-30 days)
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Left and right coronary diagnostic angiograms
Mechanism.Model_type: Deep Learning (MViT encoder + MIL linear-probing with separate within/across video attention)

Model.Purpose: Predict the probability of abnormal RV systolic function from coronary angiograms

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Research preview for RV systolic function screening from coronary angiograms.
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: Adults with L and R coronary diagnostic angiograms; input is restricted to main_structure in {Left Coronary, Right Coronary} and status=diagnostic.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Validated on MHI data only (AUC 0.820). Not validated for clinical use outside MHI.

Warnings_and_limitations.Number_of_videos: Uses up to 6 videos per study (3 Left + 3 Right typical); extra videos are ignored.
Warnings_and_limitations.Class_Imbalance: Training set was ~8% abnormal. Calibration may differ in other populations.
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Abnormal-RV threshold defaults to 0.5 on sigmoid probability and is tracked in class_mapping.json.
